shelf_grow.go.src:
package main

import "fmt"

func show(s []int) {
	fmt.Printf("len=%d cap=%d %v\n", len(s), cap(s), s)
}

func main() {
	s := make([]int, 0, 4)
	show(s)
	s = append(s, 10)
	show(s)
	s = append(s, 20, 30)
	show(s)
	s = append(s, 40)
	show(s)
	s = append(s, 50)
	show(s)
}

shelf_slice.go.src:
package main

import "fmt"

func show(s []int) {
	fmt.Printf("len=%d cap=%d %v\n", len(s), cap(s), s)
}

func main() {
	nums := []int{10, 20, 30, 40, 50}
	show(nums)
	w := nums[1:3]
	show(w)
	w = nums[3:]
	show(w)
	w = nums[:0]
	show(w)
	w = nums[1:3]
	w = w[:4]
	show(w)
}

trace_window.go.src:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	s := []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
	w := s[0:2]
	fmt.Println(0, 2, len(w), cap(w))
	w = s[1:4]
	fmt.Println(1, 4, len(w), cap(w))
	w = s[2:6]
	fmt.Println(2, 6, len(w), cap(w))
	w = s[4:4]
	fmt.Println(4, 4, len(w), cap(w))
	w = s[5:6]
	fmt.Println(5, 6, len(w), cap(w))
}
